in_sanskrit.name: Ajijul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Radiant God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ajijul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ajijul is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Aji’ meaning radiant and ‘Isana’ meaning God. This name was given to the young prince in Hindu mythology who was destined to become a powerful ruler. Ajijul is a name of strength, courage, and wisdom.
